name: OMathBreaks
description: Represents a collection of OMathBreak objects that represent all the line breaks in an equation.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified OMathBreaks object.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the OMathBreaks collection. Read-only Long.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an OMathBreak object that represents the specified item in the collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: Specifies the ordinal position of the object within the collection.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Inserts a break into an equation and returns an OMathBreak object that represents the break.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The position at which to insert the break in the equation.
